verdict.rationale: While Base44 provides a backend defined in code/config, an SDK for entity CRUD, and a CLI (docs-28, docs-29, docs-31), the evidence pack contains no mention of custom server-side functions (e.g., serverless functions) or built-in third-party integrations for payments or email that a developer could add from the builder. missing for 10: documentation of custom backend functions, payment integration (e.g., Stripe), and email service integration.
